title: Aegis — Fixed-Installation Power
headline: Resilient power, rooted in place.
tagline: Aegis is the Kronos burner in its fixed-installation housing — a D-3He tandem-mirror generator delivering firm, low-signature, sovereign power. Design stage; the burner is perfected while the breeder is built.

the-machine: The tandem mirror — central cell, high-field plugs, expander, and direct converter.
resilient-installation-power: Sovereign, low-signature, always-on power for fixed installations.
the-physics: D-3He low-neutron operation, the ambipolar potential, and the end-plug gate.
deployment-operations: Installation, balance of plant, and maintenance.
fuel-supply: Helium-3 from the breeder and the fuel cycle.
readiness-timeline: Design stage now; the first test burner and what it proves.
